description: This file defines the TemplateHandler class responsible for managing template files in SuiteCRM, including building, checking, displaying, and deleting templates, as well as generating quick search JavaScript code.

classes.name: TemplateHandler
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle of templates within the SuiteCRM system, including creation, validation, display, and deletion, along with support for quick search functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateHandler object, setting up cache directories.

methods.name: loadSmarty
methods.description: Loads the Smarty template engine if it is not already loaded.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears cached templates for all modules by calling clearCache for each bean in beanList.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Removes cached template files for a specific module and view, including theme-specific copies for consistency.

methods.name: buildTemplate
methods.description: Constructs and saves a template for a specific module and view, integrating metadata, JavaScript validation, and quick search code.

methods.name: checkTemplate
methods.description: Checks whether a cached template exists for a given module and view.

methods.name: displayTemplate
methods.description: Ensures a template exists (building it if necessary) and then fetches its content for display.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a cached template for a specific module and view, cleaning up cache files.

methods.name: createQuickSearchCode
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for quick search functionality based on metadata definitions.

methods.name: getQSDLookup
methods.description: Provides the lookup array for QuickSearchDefaults, can be extended in subclasses.
